summary: IRGC launcher redeployments in East Azerbaijan and threats against Kurdish opposition in Iraq signal heightened Iranian military posture. The IDF struck two Hamas weapon depots in Gaza, while Lebanon experienced intensive drone sightings and artillery shelling across 12 locations. The Trump administration has reportedly briefed Gulf allies for possible strikes on Iran by November 4 as nuclear talks stall over mutual preconditions.
key_points: IRGC moved at least three launchers from Tabriz–Khoy depot to multiple directions in East Azerbaijan. (Source: @shin_persian/11780)
IRGC claimed destruction of a U.S. sea drone in the Strait of Hormuz; CENTCOM denied the claim. (Source: @shin_persian/11774)
IDF destroyed Hamas weapon depots in Bureij camp and Gaza City containing RPGs, rockets, and rifles. (Source: @manniefabian/59454)
Lebanon recorded 69 alerts and 29 drone sightings on Oct 30, with artillery shelling at 12 southern locations. (Source: @redlinkleb/50643)
Pro-IRGC channel Sabereen threatened to attack Khabat party in Topzawa, Iraqi Kurdistan. (Source: @shin_persian/11781)
Trump administration briefed Gulf allies to prepare for possible strikes on Iran by November 4. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9186)
Nuclear talks stalled over U.S. demand for Iranian concessions and Iranian demand for blockade lifting. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9197)
U.S. officials Hegseth and Rubio favor further strikes to weaken Iranian regime. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9198)

sections.executive_summary: IRGC launcher redeployments in East Azerbaijan and threats against Kurdish opposition in Iraq signal heightened Iranian military posture. The IDF struck two Hamas weapon depots in Gaza, while Lebanon experienced intensive drone sightings and artillery shelling across 12 locations. The Trump administration has reportedly briefed Gulf allies for possible strikes on Iran by November 4 as nuclear talks stall over mutual preconditions.

points: IRGC claimed destruction of a U.S. sea drone in the Strait of Hormuz; U.S. CENTCOM responded that all American unmanned surface vessels are accounted for and remain on patrol, denying the claim. (Source: @shin_persian/11774)

At least three IRGC launchers with crews departed a depot on the Tabriz–Khoy road in East Azerbaijan Province, dispersing toward Jolfa Road, Bazargan, and Tabriz; additional launchers from Marand Industrial Town, including the Sepanta area and near the Sarcheshmeh Copper Laboratory, were also repositioned to city outskirts. (Source: @shin_persian/11780)

Unmanned aerial vehicle activity was observed over Piranshahr and the Iraqi border in West Azerbaijan Province at 21:24 local time (1754Z), indicating continued cross-border drone operations in the region. (Source: @shin_persian/11775)

Intense gunfire or anti-aircraft activity was reported in northern Isfahan, Isfahan Province, suggesting possible air defense engagement or training exercises in the area. (Source: @shin_persian/11772)

A Boeing 747 and an Ilyushin aircraft landed at Mehrabad Airport in Tehran with transponders off at 19:45 and 00:13 local time respectively, while the IRGC's Kandalu pier at Qeshm in Hormozgan Province undergoes reconstruction. (Source: @shin_persian/11776, @shin_persian/11783, @shin_persian/11770)

The IDF reported destroying two Hamas weapon depots in the Gaza Strip overnight: one in central Gaza's Bureij camp and another in Gaza City, which stored dozens of weapons including RPGs, explosive devices, rockets, Kalashnikov rifles, and grenades. (Source: @manniefabian/59454)
A fuel aircraft took off from Lod Airport (referred to as occupied) without appearing on radar tracking sites, prompting an alert. (Source: @redlinkleb/50623)
The Shin Bet has requested Mossad assistance in investigating the Qatari money affair related to elections, indicating internal security coordination. (Source: @amitsegal/66617)

The IDF reported destroying two Hamas weapon depots in the Gaza Strip overnight: one in central Gaza's Bureij camp and another in Gaza City, which stored dozens of weapons including RPGs, explosive devices, rockets, Kalashnikov rifles, and grenades. (Source: @manniefabian/59454)

The daily alert report for October 30, 2026 recorded 69 total alerts, including 29 drone sightings, with the highest concentration in Tyre district (29 alerts) followed by Nabatieh (25) and Marjayoun (14); the most drone-sighted villages were Al-Housh (Tyre) with 4, Al-Bazouriyah, Nabatieh, Tyre, and Burj Al-Shamali each with 3. (Source: @redlinkleb/50643)

Artillery shelling struck 12 locations across southern Lebanon, including Wadi Al-Saluqi (5 strikes), Zoutr Al-Sharqiyah (4), Wadi Zibqin (3), Mifdon (3), Al-Mansouri (2), Wadi Al-Hajir (2), Hadatha (2), Al-Qantara (1), Kfar Shuba (1), Haris (1), Tulin (1), and Kfar Tibnit (1). (Source: @redlinkleb/50643)

Additional artillery shelling was reported specifically at Zoutr Al-Sharqiyah and Mifdon, and at Wadi Zibqin and Al-Mansouri, confirming ongoing bombardment. (Source: @redlinkleb/50638, @redlinkleb/50653)

A pro-IRGC Telegram channel, Sabereen, threatened to target the Iranian Kurdish opposition Khabat party in Topzawa, Iraqi Kurdistan, urging residents to avoid residential areas where Khabat members are present. (Source: @shin_persian/11781)

UAV activity was detected over Piranshahr and the Iraqi border in West Azerbaijan Province, Iran, at 21:24 local time, indicating cross-border drone operations near the frontier. (Source: @shin_persian/11775)

The Trump administration has briefed Gulf allies to prepare for a possible short, intense round of strikes on Iran as early as November 4, the day after the U.S. midterm elections, according to three senior Gulf officials. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9186)

Nuclear talks remain stalled over two competing demands: the Trump administration insists Iran make nuclear concessions to resume talks, while Iran requires the U.S. to first lift its naval blockade, release frozen funds, and permit oil sales. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9197)

U.S. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth and Secretary of State Marco Rubio are highly skeptical of reaching any nuclear agreement with the current Iranian regime and believe Trump's legacy should include further weakening the regime through additional strikes. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9198)

President Trump stated that "the war in Iran will end soon," and that "Iran wants to talk - and we have time," while also claiming the U.S. spent seven months in the region without net cost due to Venezuelan revenue. (Source: @yediotnews25/137051, @N12chat/232531, @N12chat/232533)
